source_documents.title: Molecular packing-controlled mechanical-induced emission enhancement of tetraphenylethene functionalized pyrazoline derivatives

reference_evidence_units.quote: TPEB, TPEF, TPEN and TPECN exhibited similar absorption
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPEB, TPEF, TPEN and TPECN
reference_evidence_units.statement: Series absorption near 315 and 380 nm and emission near 525 nm are similar despite differing nonconjugated substituents.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Similarity in solution does not make solid-state behavior or yields interchangeable.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The HOMOs of TPEB and TPEF were mainly located on the pyrazoline and phenyl of phenylhydrazine moiety
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPEB and TPEF
reference_evidence_units.statement: Target HOMO is assigned to pyrazoline/phenylhydrazine and LUMO to TPE, supporting ICT.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Computed orbital localization, not a fully characterized TICT state or PET kinetics.

reference_evidence_units.quote: TPEF, TPEN and TPECN, increasing 18.7, 21.6, 11.6 and 21.5- fold, respectively.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPEB, TPEF, TPEN and TPECN
reference_evidence_units.statement: Maximum reported intensity enhancement is 18.7-fold for TPEB.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Fold change is intensity relative to THF, not quantum yield. Source Figure 3 caption repeats two names rather than correctly labeling all four panels.

reference_evidence_units.quote: confining intramolecular rotation of phenyl rings of TPE moieties.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPEB
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors assign aggregate emission enhancement to restricted rotation and vibration.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Preserve explicit target/series interpretation; not independent motion spectroscopy.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The ΦF of the ground powder dramatically increased about 2.5-fold to 28.44%.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPEB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Solid before/after grinding; integrating-sphere yields; Figure 4 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: TPEB yield increases from 12.28% to 28.44%, with peak reported 477 to 505 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Source has numerical inconsistencies: earlier initial peak is 473 nm, later 477 nm; quoted 2.5-fold is approximate. Figure 4 caption misnames panels; assignments use main text and displayed yields.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the translation of the crystalline state of the compounds was not the main reason of fluorescence enhancement.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPEB, TPEF, TPEN and TPECN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: PXRD/SEM before grinding, after grinding and heating; main-text SI S17-S18 reports.
reference_evidence_units.statement: All undergo disordering but intensity changes have opposite sign, so amorphization alone does not explain enhancement.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI patterns/images not personally inspected; conformational/packing interpretation remains indirect.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the molecules of TPEB formed anti-parallel D-A dimers.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPEB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Single-crystal Figure 5; crystals from ethanol evaporation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: TPEB has antiparallel dimers with approximately 3.60 angstrom separation and weak pi interactions; abstract calls them H-dimers.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: H/J descriptions are source packing interpretations, not independent excitonic spectral calculations.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the weak π-π interaction tumble down by grinding.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPEB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Crystal-derived interpretation of mechanically perturbed solids.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Breaking weak pi interactions is proposed to enhance TPEB emission; planarization accounts for red shift.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Ground-state packing change is inferred from crystal/solid comparisons, not a crystal structure of ground powder.

reference_evidence_units.quote: all the ground compounds could be rapidly recovered to initial state after heated for several minutes
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPEB, TPEF, TPEN and TPECN
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Grinding/heating cycles, main Figure 4; SI S16 referenced.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Heating restores the initial optical state, supporting reversible solid-state response.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Exact temperature/time details require SI; not a chemical reaction assignment.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: RIR/RIV is explicitly invoked for solution-to-aggregate emission; it is distinct from the sign of grinding response.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Target grinding enhancement is assigned to disruption of weak intermolecular pi contacts; crystalline-to-amorphous change alone is insufficient.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Source solvent comparisons and orbital calculations support ICT; no separate TICT geometry is established.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Preserve the source H-dimer/antiparallel aggregate interpretation with weak pi coupling, without claiming excimer emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: RIR/RIV is explicitly invoked for solution-to-aggregate emission; it is distinct from the sign of grinding response.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Target grinding enhancement is assigned to disruption of weak intermolecular pi contacts; crystalline-to-amorphous change alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No guest-binding or inclusion mechanism linked to target emission established; solvent polarity alone does not establish host-guest binding.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Source solvent comparisons and orbital calculations support ICT; no separate TICT geometry is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer mechanism established; hydrogen bonding or ground-state acid-base chemistry alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No separate photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on established; intramolecular CT is not automatically PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Preserve the source H-dimer/antiparallel aggregate interpretation with weak pi coupling, without claiming excimer emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct radiative-rate or bright/dark-state mechanism established beyond generic changes in fluorescence intensity.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet, metal-centered or energy-transfer emissive mechanism established in the selected conditions.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection-mediated nonradiative pathway established; twisting alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No emission from higher excited states or suppression of Kasha's rule established.
